name: qlrisk_credit_risk
title: Credit risk measures
description: Credit-risk calculators: pd (Merton, reduced form, transition matrix, logistic, historical), lgd (fixed, collateral, workout, market, stochastic), ead (CEM, IMM, SA-CCR), el (PD x LGD x EAD), economic_capital (Vasicek, Gordy, Monte Carlo) and raroc. Inputs: measure, inputs (fields carry their unit, * = required: el takes pd_pct*, lgd_pct, ead; economic_capital exposures*, pds_pct*, lgds_pct*), config (model or method). Example: {"measure": "el", "inputs": {"pd_pct": 2, "lgd_pct": 45, "ead": 1000000}} gives EL: 9,000.00.
